title: MyoSem: Aligning Electromyography with Natural-Language Action Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2606.00174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electromyography (EMG) records muscle activation for hand gesture recognition, prosthetic control, and wearable interaction. Existing EMG methods usually formulate hand action understanding as prediction over fixed gesture labels, leaving EMG signals and action-semantic text unaligned in a common feature space and limiting bidirectional querying between signals and hand-action descriptions. We present MyoSem, an EMG--action semantic alignment framework that maps hand EMG and multi-view natural-language action descriptions into a shared feature space for retrieval. MyoSem builds semantic prototypes from multi-view descriptions, encodes EMG with local activation-aware representations, and uses semantic queries to aggregate local EMG evidence for bidirectional EMG--text retrieval. We evaluate MyoSem under seven protocols on NinaPro DB2, EMG2Pose, and NinaPro DB2$\rightarrow$DB3, covering random splits, user shifts, held-out action

translated_title: MyoSem：将肌电信号与自然语言动作语义对齐
translated_abstract: 肌电图（EMG）通过记录肌肉激活信号，被应用于手势识别、假肢控制和可穿戴交互等领域。现有的EMG方法通常将手部动作理解任务表述为对固定手势标签的预测，导致EMG信号与动作语义文本未能在共同特征空间中对齐，限制了信号与手部动作描述之间的双向查询能力。我们提出了MyoSem，一个EMG-动作语义对齐框架，将手部EMG信号与多视角自然语言动作描述映射到共享特征空间中以实现检索。MyoSem从多视角描述中构建语义原型，采用局部激活感知表示对EMG进行编码，并利用语义查询聚合局部EMG证据，从而实现双向的EMG-文本检索。我们在NinaPro DB2、EMG2Pose以及NinaPro DB2→DB3跨数据集上，通过七种评估协议对MyoSem进行了评估，涵盖随机划分、用户偏移、保留动作等场景。
tldr: MyoSem提出了一个肌电-动作语义对齐框架，将手部EMG信号与多视角自然语言动作描述映射到共享特征空间，通过语义原型构建、局部激活感知编码和语义查询聚合，实现了双向的EMG-文本检索，突破了传统固定手势标签分类的局限。
en_tdlr: MyoSem proposes an EMG-action semantic alignment framework that maps hand EMG signals and multi-view natural-language action descriptions into a shared feature space, enabling bidirectional EMG-text retrieval through semantic prototype construction, local activation-aware encoding, and semantic query aggregation, overcoming the limitations of conventional fixed gesture-label classification.
